results.evidence: Application-owned redirects are ledgered one-to-one and representative canonical host/path combinations resolve in exactly one application hop; legacy path targets are absolute canonical-origin URLs.
Static redirect tracing rejects chains/loops; www + /credits and www + /cbam-methodology collapse directly to canonical final targets instead of path-then-host chains.
HSTS remains max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains and the preload token is removed because no explicit irreversible HSTS-preload approval is recorded.
All three application-owned redirect rules are explicitly reviewed with KEEP decisions, rationale and UTC review timestamps. Historical creation age is not fabricated; ageKnown remains false.
Live registry routes are case-fold unique, lowercase and non-trailing; Next trailing-slash normalization is not disabled; non-canonical 2xx response fixtures are rejected.
3 application redirect rules use 15 basis points of the configured 2000-rule capacity; configured warning threshold is 80%.
